metaTitle: Custom Frosted Tote Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom frosted tote bags in bulk for your next event or promotion. Durable, stylish, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Frosted tote bags offer a subtle, translucent look that stands out from standard opaque totes. Made from durable polypropylene, these bags are lightweight yet strong enough for groceries, trade show giveaways, or retail packaging. The frosted material provides a modern, semi-clear finish that pairs well with bold logo prints. Perfect for brands seeking a clean, contemporary aesthetic without the cost of clear vinyl. Decorate with screen printing or heat transfer for a crisp, professional result.
heroAltText: Custom frosted tote bags with company logo, semi-transparent polypropylene material, modern and durable for bulk orders.
